papers.title: Microbiome changes following immigration: Rethinking "Westernization" as an explanatory concept
papers.authors: Sharma R, Holcomb L, Ishaq S, O'Doherty K
papers.abstract: An emerging focus in microbiome science is on changes to people's microbiomes following immigration, particularly to so-called Western countries, such as the USA, Canada, and Australia. Moving to these regions has been linked to microbiome changes that may increase immigrants' susceptibility to health problems, including obesity and Inflammatory Bowel Disease. The term "Westernization" (and adjacent terminology) is frequently used to describe changes in diet, lifestyle, and built environment - and the consequent microbiome shifts - associated with immigration. However, what Westernization means in this context, and whether it is an appropriate descriptor, is often unclear. The purpose of this article is to provide a review of the diverse meanings associated with the terms "West", "Western", "Westernization" (and similar) across microbiome-related research and broader uses. We argue that these terms can obscure the specific structural, environmental, and cultural factors shaping microbiome changes. We discuss the consequences of this imprecision and provide recommendations for future research. Avoiding oversimplified conclusions about what impacts immigrants' microbiome and health can contribute to more accurate targets for public health interventions for these groups in the long term.

papers.abstract_zh: 微生物相科學中一個新興的研究焦點，是人們移民後的微生物相變化，尤其是移居至美國、加拿大及澳洲等所謂西方國家之後的變化。移居至這些地區與微生物相變化有關，而這些變化可能增加移民對健康問題的易感性，包括肥胖及發炎性腸道疾病。「西化」（及相關術語）經常被用來描述與移民相關的飲食、生活型態及建成環境變化，以及隨之而來的微生物相轉變。然而，在此脈絡下，西化的意義為何，以及它是否為適切的描述用語，往往並不清楚。本文旨在回顧微生物相相關研究及更廣泛使用情境中，「西方」、「西方的」、「西化」（及類似用語）所承載的多種意義。我們主張，這些用語可能掩蓋形塑微生物相變化的特定結構性、環境及文化因素。我們討論這種不精確性所造成的後果，並提出未來研究的建議。避免對影響移民微生物相及健康的因素做出過度簡化的結論，長期而言，有助於為這些族群的公共衛生介入措施訂定更精確的目標。

papers.title: Cell-type-specific programmed cell death imbalance drives immune checkpoint blockade resistance in microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer
papers.journal_full: Apoptosis : an international journal on programmed cell death
papers.authors: Yi J, Wu S, He H
papers.abstract: Programmed cell death (PCD) is a metabolically controlled decision point that shapes antitumor immunity, and its dysregulation is increasingly recognized as a central driver of immune‑checkpoint‑blockade (ICB) resistance in microsatellite‑stable (MSS) colorectal cancer (CRC). Mechanistically, this review focuses on the cell-type-specific molecular switches that determine whether PCD drives immunosuppression or immunogenic cell death. In this review, we propose a unified mechanistic framework centered on a dual PCD imbalance: dysregulated tumor microenvironment (TME) metabolism predominantly activates pyroptosis, ferroptosis, and apoptosis in antitumor immune cells-an immunosuppressive outcome that depends on cell type, stimulus, and tissue context-while tumor-intrinsic epigenetic silencing preferentially abolishes necroptosis, cuproptosis, and PANoptosis in tumor cells, blocking DAMP release and de novo T cell priming. Four stromal and immune subsets drive distinct metabolic cascades: cancer‑associated fibroblasts fuel lactate‑mediated dendritic cell pyroptosis and CD8⁺ T cell ferroptosis; tumor‑associated macrophages amplify lipid‑peroxidation‑driven ferroptosis; myeloid‑derived suppressor cells induce T cell apoptosis via amino acid deprivation; and regulatory T cells exploit kynurenine and adenosine signaling to eliminate antitumor lymphocytes. These cellular insults are reinforced by soluble amplifiers (TGF‑β, IL‑10/IL‑35, adenosine) and VEGF‑driven hypoxia, forming a redundant immunosuppressive network. We hypothesize that this dual PCD imbalance-sustained suppressive PCD of antitumor immune cells combined with silenced immunogenic PCD of tumor cells-locks MSS CRC in an immune‑cold state and explains why single‑agent therapies consistently fail. Accordingly, CMS‑stratified combinatorial regimens that concurrently restrain suppressive PCD and awaken immunogenic tumor cell death may be required to overcome ICB resistance. Emerging approaches spanning spatial multi‑omics, gut microbiota targeting, and myeloid checkpoint inhibition provide opportunities to remodel the cold TME and translate this metabolic‑PCD framework into subtype‑tailored precision immunotherapy for MSS CRC. This dual-PCD-imbalance framework is a testable working hypothesis requiring further combinatorial validation in MSS-CRC-relevant systems.

papers.title_zh: 細胞類型特異性的程序性細胞死亡失衡驅動微衛星穩定型大腸直腸癌對免疫檢查點阻斷治療的抗藥性
papers.abstract_zh: 程序性細胞死亡（PCD）是受代謝調控、形塑抗腫瘤免疫的決策節點；其失調日益被認為是微衛星穩定型（MSS）大腸直腸癌（CRC）對免疫檢查點阻斷治療（ICB）產生抗藥性的核心驅動因素。在機轉層面，本綜述聚焦於具有細胞類型特異性的分子開關，這些開關決定PCD究竟促進免疫抑制，還是引發免疫原性細胞死亡。本綜述提出以雙重PCD失衡為核心的統一機轉框架：失調的腫瘤微環境（TME）代謝，主要在抗腫瘤免疫細胞中活化細胞焦亡、鐵死亡與細胞凋亡，其免疫抑制結果取決於細胞類型、刺激及組織情境；另一方面，腫瘤細胞內在的表觀遺傳沉默，則優先使腫瘤細胞的壞死性凋亡、銅死亡及PANoptosis失效，阻斷損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的釋放與新的T細胞初始活化。四種基質與免疫細胞亞群驅動不同的代謝級聯反應：癌症相關纖維母細胞促進乳酸介導的樹突細胞焦亡及CD8⁺ T細胞鐵死亡；腫瘤相關巨噬細胞放大脂質過氧化驅動的鐵死亡；骨髓源抑制細胞透過胺基酸剝奪誘發T細胞凋亡；調節型T細胞則利用犬尿氨酸及腺苷訊號，消除抗腫瘤淋巴球。這些細胞損傷又受到可溶性放大因子（TGF-β、IL-10／IL-35、腺苷）及VEGF驅動的缺氧所強化，形成具有多重備援路徑的免疫抑制網絡。我們假設，這種雙重PCD失衡，也就是抗腫瘤免疫細胞持續發生具免疫抑制作用的PCD，同時腫瘤細胞的免疫原性PCD遭到沉默，會將MSS CRC鎖定於免疫冷腫瘤狀態，並解釋為何單一藥物治療持續失敗。因此，可能需要依共識分子亞型（CMS）分層的合併治療方案，同時抑制具免疫抑制作用的PCD，並喚醒腫瘤細胞的免疫原性死亡，才能克服ICB抗藥性。涵蓋空間多體學、腸道微生物群標靶及骨髓系免疫檢查點抑制的新興方法，提供了重塑冷腫瘤微環境的機會，並有望將此代謝－PCD框架轉化為依亞型量身打造的MSS CRC精準免疫治療。這個雙重PCD失衡框架是一項可供檢驗的工作假說，仍需在與MSS CRC相關的系統中進一步進行組合驗證。

papers.title: Automated Clinical Decision Support and Electronic Health Record Tracking of Patients With Adenomas Found on Colonoscopy
papers.authors: O'Brien M, Spann A, Zahn L, McCoy A, Horst S
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Surveillance colonoscopy following adenoma detection is essential for colorectal cancer prevention, yet systematic tracking within electronic health record (EHR) systems remains challenging, as they rely on manual data entry.
OBJECTIVE: To determine if implementation of an automatic tool in the EHR is associated with improved health care maintenance table updates for patients needing repeat colonoscopy for cancer screening after adenoma detection.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study at a single tertiary care center within a large health care organization with EHR functionality included patients undergoing colonoscopy between November 2017 and December 2024. Eligible participants were adults aged 50 to 75 years undergoing colonoscopy for screening, surveillance, or diagnostic indications. Exclusion criteria included patients with inflammatory bowel disease, known colorectal cancer, or hereditary cancer syndromes. Data were analyzed between January and May 2025.
EXPOSURE: A decision support tool was implemented that allowed gastroenterologists completing colonoscopies for patients with adenoma to choose follow-up intervals that would automatically populate the health maintenance tab.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Rate of updates of the health maintenance table and percentage completion from gastroenterology vs primary care.
RESULTS: A total of 35 802 patients met criteria (20 049 female [56.0%]; median [range] age: preintervention, 61 years [50-75 years]; postintervention, 62 years [50-75 years]); adenomas were detected in 8004 of 18 027 patients (44.4%) in the preintervention period and 8396 of 17 775 patients (47.2%) in the postintervention period. Health maintenance updates for patients with adenomas requiring closer surveillance increased significantly, from 83.4% (6672 of 8004 patients) to 94.2% (7913 of 8396 patients) following the intervention (P < .001). Gastroenterology team completion of health maintenance updates increased postintervention from 67.6% (5413 of 8004 patients) to 91.9% (7717 of 8396 patients). Conversely, primary care team updates decreased significantly from 9.3% (746 of 8004 patients) to 1.4% (118 of 8396 patients) following the intervention (P < .001 for both). Population health automatic updates occurred in a small number of patients in both periods.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Implementation of automatic updates to the health maintenance section of the EHR was associated with significantly increased the reliability of postadenoma surveillance documentation; after the intervention, gastroenterology reporting increased while the primary care burden was reduced. These findings suggest that clinical decision support implementation is critical for accurate adenoma surveillance intervals.

papers.title_zh: 自動化臨床決策支援與電子病歷追蹤大腸鏡發現腺瘤的病人
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：發現腺瘤後進行監測性大腸鏡檢查，對預防大腸直腸癌至關重要；然而，由於電子病歷（EHR）系統仰賴人工輸入資料，在其中進行系統性追蹤仍具挑戰。
目的：探討在EHR導入自動化工具，是否與改善腺瘤檢出後需再次接受大腸鏡癌症篩檢病人的健康維護表更新情形有關。
研究設計、場域與參與者：這項世代研究於一個具備EHR功能的大型醫療組織內之單一三級照護中心進行，納入2017年11月至2024年12月接受大腸鏡檢查的病人。符合資格者為50至75歲、因篩檢、監測或診斷適應症接受大腸鏡檢查的成人。排除條件包括發炎性腸道疾病、已知大腸直腸癌或遺傳性癌症症候群。資料於2025年1月至5月間分析。
暴露：導入一項決策支援工具，讓為腺瘤病人完成大腸鏡檢查的腸胃科醫師選擇追蹤間隔，並自動將該資訊填入健康維護頁籤。
主要結果與測量：健康維護表的更新率，以及由腸胃科團隊與基層照護團隊完成更新的百分比。
結果：共有35,802名病人符合條件，其中20,049名為女性（56.0%）；年齡中位數［範圍］在介入前為61歲［50至75歲］，介入後為62歲［50至75歲］。介入前18,027名病人中有8,004名（44.4%）檢出腺瘤，介入後17,775名病人中有8,396名（47.2%）檢出腺瘤。對於需要較密集監測的腺瘤病人，健康維護資料更新率在介入後顯著增加，從83.4%（8,004人中的6,672人）提高至94.2%（8,396人中的7,913人）（P<.001）。腸胃科團隊完成健康維護資料更新的比例，在介入後由67.6%（8,004人中的5,413人）增加至91.9%（8,396人中的7,717人）。相反地，基層照護團隊更新的比例在介入後由9.3%（8,004人中的746人）顯著下降至1.4%（8,396人中的118人）（上述兩項比較均為P<.001）。兩個時期均有少數病人透過族群健康管理功能自動更新。
結論與相關性：在EHR健康維護區段導入自動更新，與腺瘤切除後監測紀錄可靠性的顯著提升有關；介入後，腸胃科通報增加，而基層照護負擔降低。這些發現提示，導入臨床決策支援對於準確記錄腺瘤監測間隔至關重要。

papers.title: Th17 suppression strategies: targeting IL-17 and RORγt pathways in autoimmune diseases
papers.authors: Zian Z, Aliyu M, Hossain F, Zohora F, Ceylan A, Ben Moussa N
papers.abstract: T helper 17 (Th17) cells and their key effector cytokine, particularly IL-17A and IL-17F, play central roles in host defense against extracellular pathogens. However, they are also critically involved in the pathogenesis of many autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Th17 cell differentiation, stabilization, plasticity, and pathogenicity are regulated by a network of cytokines and transcription factors, including IL-6, TGF-β, IL-23, STAT3, and the key transcription factor RORγt. RORγt-dependent pathways are also relevant to other immune populations, including group 3 innate lymphoid cells (ILC3s), highlighting the complexity of the IL-17 axis across tissues. Dysregulation of these pathways can lead to chronic inflammation and tissue damage in diseases such as psoriasis, rheumatoid arthritis, multiple sclerosis, and inflammatory bowel disease. Therapeutic targeting of the Th17 axis has led to clinically established approaches, particularly direct blockade of IL-17 signaling and inhibition of IL-23, whereas direct RORγt inhibition remains an investigational strategy. RORγt inhibitors may modulate Th17 differentiation and broader RORγt-dependent transcriptional programs, but their clinical development has been challenged by variable efficacy, safety considerations, and translational limitations. This review provides a comprehensive overview of Th17 biology, focusing on differentiation, plasticity, tissue-specific functions, and the contribution of Th17 and other RORγt-expression populations to autoimmune diseases. Furthermore, it critically compares established IL-17-targeted therapies with emerging RORγt inhibitors, emphasizing their distinct mechanisms, cellular and molecular targets, clinical evidence, safety, and developmental status. Finally, we discuss combination strategies, translational challenges, and emerging biomarkers that may contribute to more individualized therapeutic approaches and patient stratification.

papers.abstract_zh: 輔助型T細胞17（Th17）及其關鍵效應細胞激素，尤其是IL-17A與IL-17F，在宿主抵禦細胞外病原體方面扮演核心角色。然而，它們也深度參與許多自體免疫與發炎性疾病的致病機轉。Th17細胞的分化、穩定性、可塑性及致病性，受到細胞激素與轉錄因子網絡的調控，包括IL-6、TGF-β、IL-23、STAT3，以及關鍵轉錄因子RORγt。RORγt依賴性路徑也與其他免疫細胞族群有關，包括第3型先天淋巴細胞（ILC3），凸顯IL-17軸在不同組織中的複雜性。這些路徑失調可導致乾癬、類風濕性關節炎、多發性硬化症及發炎性腸道疾病等疾病中的慢性發炎與組織損傷。以Th17軸為治療標的，已促成臨床上確立的治療方式，尤其是直接阻斷IL-17訊號傳遞及抑制IL-23；相較之下，直接抑制RORγt仍屬研究中的策略。RORγt抑制劑可能調節Th17分化及更廣泛的RORγt依賴性轉錄程序，但其臨床開發面臨療效不一、安全性考量及轉譯限制等挑戰。本綜述全面概述Th17生物學，聚焦於分化、可塑性、組織特異性功能，以及Th17和其他表現RORγt的細胞族群對自體免疫疾病的作用。此外，本文批判性比較已確立的IL-17標靶治療與新興RORγt抑制劑，著重於兩者不同的作用機轉、細胞與分子標的、臨床證據、安全性及開發階段。最後，我們討論合併治療策略、轉譯挑戰及新興生物標記，這些可能有助於發展更個別化的治療方式及病人分層。

papers.title: Multiple Primary Cancers in Colorectal Cancer Survivors: A Comprehensive Narrative Review of Epidemiology, Genetics and Clinical Implications
papers.authors: Melku M, Symonds E, Thurgood L, Winter J, Best O
papers.abstract: With rising global incidence and improved survival, colorectal cancer (CRC) survivors face an increasing risk of developing multiple primary cancers (MPCs). Despite the growing clinical significance, the epidemiology, molecular basis and optimal clinical management of MPCs remain incompletely understood. This narrative review summarises historical perspectives on the definition of MPCs and synthesises current epidemiological, clinical and molecular evidence on MPCs among CRC survivors, focusing on incidence, risk factors, biological mechanisms, mortality and clinical implications of MPCs in CRC survivors. Available evidence indicate that up to 20% of CRC survivors develop one or more subsequent MPCs, with risk influenced by age at diagnosis of the index CRC, sex, tumour characteristics, comorbidities and variation in tumour coding practices. Survivors diagnosed before the age of 50 years have the highest risk of MPCs. The most commonly reported MPCs include gastrointestinal, prostate, breast, lung, urinary tract, haematological and gynaecological cancers. The presence of MPCs is associated with substantially poorer outcomes and increased mortality, with deaths frequently attributable to lung, gastrointestinal, prostate, urinary tract and haematological cancers. The molecular mechanisms underlying MPC development are poorly understood. Although germline pathogenic variants account for a subset of cases, evidence suggest that somatic mutations, tumour mutational burden and field cancerisation may contribute to the development of multiple malignancies. However, no consistent molecular drivers of MPCs have been identified. Clinical management is further complicated by the absence of evidence-based guidelines, under-representation of cancer survivors in clinical trials, biological heterogeneity of tumours and the complexity of synchronous and metachronous disease presentations. In conclusion, MPCs represent an increasingly important challenge in CRC survivorship and contribute substantially to long-term morbidity and mortality. Future advances will require integration of large-scale clinical and molecular datasets, improved understanding of underlying biological mechanisms and development of risk-stratified surveillance and treatment strategies. Progress in preclinical disease models and targeted therapies may ultimately improve outcomes for the growing survivor population.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌存活者的多重原發癌：流行病學、遺傳學與臨床意涵的全面敘述性綜述
papers.abstract_zh: 隨著全球發生率上升與存活改善，大腸直腸癌（CRC）存活者面臨日益增加的多重原發癌（MPCs）發生風險。儘管其臨床重要性日增，MPCs 的流行病學、分子基礎與最佳臨床處置仍未被充分了解。本敘述性綜述整理 MPCs 定義的歷史觀點，並整合 CRC 存活者發生 MPCs 的現有流行病學、臨床與分子證據，聚焦於其發生率、危險因子、生物機轉、死亡率及臨床意涵。現有證據顯示，高達 20% 的 CRC 存活者會在後續發生一種或多種 MPCs，其風險受到首次 CRC 診斷年齡、性別、腫瘤特徵、共病及腫瘤編碼實務差異的影響。於 50 歲前確診的存活者，其 MPCs 風險最高。最常被報告的 MPCs 包括胃腸道癌、攝護腺癌、乳癌、肺癌、泌尿道癌、血液惡性腫瘤及婦科癌症。MPCs 的存在與明顯較差的預後及較高死亡率相關，死亡原因經常歸因於肺癌、胃腸道癌、攝護腺癌、泌尿道癌及血液惡性腫瘤。對於 MPCs 發生的分子機轉，目前仍了解有限。雖然部分病例可歸因於生殖系致病變異，但證據顯示，體細胞突變、腫瘤突變負荷及區域癌化可能參與多重惡性腫瘤的發生。然而，目前尚未辨識出一致的 MPCs 分子驅動因子。缺乏實證指引、癌症存活者在臨床試驗中的代表性不足、腫瘤的生物異質性，以及同步與異時性疾病表現的複雜性，使臨床處置更加困難。總之，MPCs 是 CRC 存活者照護中日益重要的挑戰，並對長期罹病與死亡造成重大影響。未來的進展將需要整合大規模臨床與分子資料集、增進對底層生物機轉的理解，以及發展依風險分層的監測與治療策略。臨床前疾病模型及標靶治療的進步，最終可能改善日益增加的癌症存活者族群之預後。

papers.title: From ASCOLT to ALASCCA: A Practical Framework for Biomarker-Selected Adjuvant Aspirin in PI3K-Altered Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Sagawa T, Hirakawa M, Nagashima H, Fujikawa K
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Postoperative aspirin has produced inconsistent results in molecularly unselected colorectal cancer, whereas ALASCCA supports a biomarker-selected strategy. We synthesize randomized, molecular, and mechanistic evidence and propose a cautious framework for clinical consideration.
METHODS: This clinically oriented narrative review searched PubMed/MEDLINE, ClinicalTrials.gov, jRCT, PROSPERO, ASCO and ESMO materials, and reference lists, with a final update on September 27, 2026. Randomized trials and prospective biomarker-selected evidence were prioritized.
RESULTS: ASCOLT and EPISODE-III/JCOG1503C did not meet their primary disease-free survival endpoints in unselected populations. SAKK 41/13 was underpowered but directionally supportive. In ALASCCA, aspirin 160 mg daily for 3 years reduced 3-year colorectal cancer recurrence in group A PIK3CA exon 9/20 hotspot tumors (7.7% vs. 14.1%; HR 0.49, 95% CI 0.24-0.98). Group B showed a favorable estimate (7.7% vs. 16.8%; HR 0.42, 95% CI 0.21-0.83) but was secondary and molecularly heterogeneous. Low-dose platelet COX-1/thromboxane inhibition is pharmacologically established; direct tumor-cell COX-2/PI3K effects remain less certain. Mature overall-survival data are lacking.
CONCLUSION: Adjuvant aspirin should not be used universally after colorectal cancer resection. The strongest evidence applies to ALASCCA group A, while group B requires variant-level caution. Any use should preserve standard adjuvant therapy and incorporate bleeding risk, local guidance, and shared decision-making.

結果：ASCOLT 與 EPISODE-III/JCOG1503C 在未經篩選的族群中，均未達到主要無病存活終點。SAKK 41/13 的統計檢定力不足，但結果方向支持使用 aspirin。在 ALASCCA 中，每日使用 aspirin 160 mg、持續 3 年，可降低 A 組 PIK3CA 第 9／20 外顯子熱點突變腫瘤病人的 3 年大腸直腸癌復發率（7.7% vs. 14.1%；HR 0.49，95% CI 0.24–0.98）。B 組也呈現有利的效果估計值（7.7% vs. 16.8%；HR 0.42，95% CI 0.21–0.83），但屬次要分析，且分子特徵具有異質性。低劑量 aspirin 對血小板 COX-1／血栓素的抑制作用，在藥理學上已確立；其直接作用於腫瘤細胞 COX-2／PI3K 的效果則仍較不確定。目前缺乏成熟的整體存活資料。
結論：大腸直腸癌切除術後不應全面使用輔助性 aspirin。最強的證據適用於 ALASCCA A 組，而 B 組則須依個別變異審慎判斷。任何使用均應保留標準輔助治療，並納入出血風險、在地指引與醫病共同決策。

papers.title: Inferior mesenteric artery morphology and its branching variations: a meta-analysis of 9358 patients with implications for colorectal surgery
papers.authors: Koszewski J, Wilk J, Drozd M, Gliwa J, Plutecki D, Walocha J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) is a crucial artery that supplies the colon and rectum. As colorectal cancer is most commonly localized in the descending and sigmoid colon, as well as in the rectum, detailed knowledge of the anatomy of the IMA is of utmost importance for oncological surgeons performing hemicolectomies.
METHODS: An extensive search of major databases was performed up to April 2026 for studies detailing the morphometry, anatomy, and variations of the IMA. The study strictly adhered to the PRISMA guidelines. Out of 143,884 initial records, 66 original studies met the inclusion criteria. A random effects model was applied in the statistical analyses, and heterogeneity was evaluated using Chi-squared and I-squared statistics.
RESULTS: The IMA most often originated at the L3 vertebral level (60.35%). The number of sigmoid arteries varied across the study groups, with 2 sigmoid arteries variant being the most common variant at 38.42%, followed by 3 sigmoid arteries variant at 31.30%. Across IMA branching pattern classification systems, the most prevalent anatomical variations were Type 1 in the modified Yada scale (47.39%), Type 1 in Latarjet scale (47.39%), Type 1B in McSweeney scale (45.51%), and Type B in modified Zebrowski scale (20.35%).
CONCLUSIONS: To standardize complex branching patterns, we propose supplementing the modified Yada scale with the exact number of sigmoid arteries for clinical practice, while recommending the McSweeney scale for prospective research. Surgeons must account for significant anatomical variability, as IMA originates at the L3 level in only 60.42% of cases, and the number of sigmoid arteries varies widely, most commonly presenting as two or three. Ultimately, accurate preoperative visualization and standardized IMA categorization are crucial for optimal surgical outcomes.
papers.title_zh: 下腸繫膜動脈的形態與分支變異：納入9358名患者的統合分析及其對大腸直腸手術的意涵
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：下腸繫膜動脈（IMA）是供應結腸與直腸的重要動脈。由於大腸直腸癌最常位於降結腸、乙狀結腸及直腸，對執行半結腸切除術的腫瘤外科醫師而言，詳細了解IMA解剖至關重要。
方法：廣泛搜尋主要資料庫，納入截至2026年4月描述IMA形態測量、解剖及變異的研究。本研究嚴格遵循PRISMA指引。最初取得143,884筆紀錄，其中66篇原始研究符合納入條件。統計分析採用隨機效應模型，並以卡方及I平方統計量評估異質性。
結果：IMA最常起源於第3腰椎（L3）高度（60.35%）。各研究群體的乙狀結腸動脈數目有所不同，以2條最常見，占38.42%，其次為3條，占31.30%。在各種IMA分支型態分類系統中，最常見的解剖變異分別為修正版Yada分類的第1型（47.39%）、Latarjet分類的第1型（47.39%）、McSweeney分類的第1B型（45.51%），以及修正版Zebrowski分類的B型（20.35%）。
結論：為使複雜的分支型態標準化，我們建議在臨床實務中，於修正版Yada分類補充乙狀結腸動脈的確切數目；前瞻性研究則建議採用McSweeney分類。外科醫師必須考量顯著的解剖變異，因為IMA僅在60.42%的病例中起源於L3高度，而乙狀結腸動脈數目差異很大，最常見為2條或3條。總而言之，精確的術前影像呈現與標準化的IMA分類，對達成最佳手術結果至關重要。

papers.title: Shared decision making and patient satisfaction in colorectal cancer screening: a multicentric cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Selva A, Torà N, Hortala Bas C, López López P, Machlab S, Burón A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) screening programs reduce incidence and mortality, but their success depends not only on clinical effectiveness but also on participants' experience and satisfaction. Understanding these dimensions is crucial, as poor satisfaction or limited involvement in shared decision-making (SDM) can undermine uptake and adherence. This study evaluated SDM and satisfaction among participants with a positive fecal immunochemical test (FIT) in an organized CRC screening program in Catalonia.
METHODS: A multicenter cross-sectional study was conducted from November 2020 to December 2021 across three hospitals. Participants aged 50-69 with a positive FIT result were surveyed after colonoscopy and diagnosis. SDM was measured using CollaboRATE and SDM-Q-9; satisfaction was assessed using Hatoum's and Colonoscopy Safety and Satisfaction Questionnaire questionnaires and custom tools. Multivariate analyses identified factors associated with SDM and satisfaction.
RESULTS: Of 846 invited, 824 were included and 694 completed questionnaires (84.2% response rate). Overall, 39.8% achieved the CollaboRATE top score. Higher SDM was linked to shorter wait times, use of Moviprep®,a bowel preparation solution, and absence of complications. Among CRC-diagnosed patients, women and those with a personal cancer history reported higher SDM. Overall satisfaction was high (mean 9.4/10), though bowel preparation scored lowest. Satisfaction varied by hospital, preparation type, and patient characteristics, but not by final diagnosis.
CONCLUSIONS: Participants reported high satisfaction but moderate SDM, revealing room for improvement. Factors such as preparation type, waiting time, and communication quality shaped patient experience. Differences across centers suggest organizational factors matter. Strengthening communication, reducing delays, and addressing patient diversity are essential to enhance satisfaction and engagement, key drivers of CRC screening program effectiveness.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌篩檢中的共同決策與病人滿意度：多中心橫斷面研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢計畫可降低發生率與死亡率，但其成功不僅取決於臨床效益，也取決於參與者的經驗與滿意度。了解這些面向至關重要，因為滿意度不佳或共同決策（SDM）參與不足，可能削弱篩檢參與及依從性。本研究評估加泰隆尼亞一項有組織的CRC篩檢計畫中，糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）陽性參與者的SDM與滿意度。
方法：本多中心橫斷面研究於2020年11月至2021年12月在三家醫院進行。針對50至69歲、FIT結果陽性的參與者，於大腸鏡檢查及診斷後進行問卷調查。SDM使用CollaboRATE與SDM-Q-9量表測量；滿意度則使用Hatoum問卷、大腸鏡安全與滿意度問卷，以及自訂工具評估。透過多變項分析辨識與SDM及滿意度相關的因素。
結果：846名受邀者中，824名納入研究，694名完成問卷（回覆率84.2%）。整體而言，39.8%的參與者在CollaboRATE獲得最高分。較高的SDM與較短的等待時間、使用腸道準備溶液Moviprep®及未發生併發症相關。在確診CRC的病人中，女性及有個人癌症病史者回報較高的SDM。整體滿意度高（平均9.4/10分），但腸道準備的評分最低。滿意度因醫院、腸道準備類型及病人特徵而異，但不因最終診斷而異。
結論：參與者回報高滿意度，但SDM程度中等，顯示仍有改善空間。腸道準備類型、等待時間與溝通品質等因素形塑了病人經驗。各中心間的差異提示組織因素具有重要性。加強溝通、減少延遲及因應病人的多樣性，對提升滿意度與參與程度至關重要，而這兩者是CRC篩檢計畫成效的重要驅動因素。

papers.title: Pre-treatment T2WI-based automated artificial intelligence system for predicting neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response and prognosis in locally advanced rectal cancer: a multicenter study
papers.ptype: Multicenter Study, Research Support, Non-U.S. Gov't
papers.authors: Sun K, Lu S, Li X, Wang Y, Jiang Z, Wang X
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: In clinical practice, approximately 15-25% of patients with locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC) achieve a pathological complete response (pCR), defined as tumor regression grade 0 according to the AJCC 8th edition, which is closely associated with favorable prognosis. However, noninvasive and accurate preoperative assessment methods remain a major clinical challenge. We aimed to develop an automated artificial intelligence (AI) system for predicting the response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and prognosis in LARC using pre-treatment T2WI.
METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study included 227 LARC patients from Center 1 as the development cohort and 72 and 55 patients from two separate centers as external validation cohorts 1 and 2, respectively. 3D Swin-UNETR was constructed to automatically identify LARC tumors. Based on the segmented tumor volumes, three analytical approaches were implemented to support downstream tasks. Specifically, 1,132 radiomic features (Rf) were extracted using PyRadiomics, while 2,048 deep learning features (Dlf) were derived by 3D ResNet-152 architecture. Following a series of feature selection steps, predictive response scores were generated, including RF scores (Rfs) and Dlf scores (Dlfs). Additionally, an end-to-end analysis was performed to automatically generate Dl scores (Dls). A multi-perspective feature engineering model was then developed by integrating Rfs, Dlfs, and Dls. The predictive performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curves (AUROCs). Prognostic indices, including disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS), were assessed using Kaplan-Meier (KM) analysis, with the Log-Rank test used to compare KM curves.
RESULTS: The fusion model achieved moderate AUROCs of 0.756 and 0.751 in external validation cohorts 1 and 2, respectively. It effectively stratified OS risk, with p-values < 0.05 across all cohorts. For DFS, statistical significance was inconsistent across cohorts, being achieved in the development cohort (p = 0.0084) and external cohort 2 (p = 0.044), but not in external cohort 1 (p = 0.068). These findings are exploratory and require prospective confirmation.
CONCLUSIONS: The proposed AI system demonstrates moderate, externally validated performance for assessing treatment response and OS risk stratification in LARC and may serve as a decision-support tool to assist clinical judgment.

papers.title_zh: 以治療前T2WI為基礎的自動化人工智慧系統，預測局部進展期直腸癌的新輔助化學放射治療反應與預後：多中心研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：臨床實務中，約15–25%的局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）患者可達病理完全緩解（pCR），依AJCC第8版定義為腫瘤退縮分級0級，且與良好預後密切相關。然而，非侵入性且準確的術前評估方法仍是重大臨床挑戰。本研究旨在利用治療前T2WI，開發自動化人工智慧（AI）系統，以預測LARC對新輔助化學放射治療的反應及預後。
方法：本多中心回溯性研究納入中心1的227名LARC患者作為開發隊列，另納入兩個不同中心的72名及55名患者，分別作為外部驗證隊列1及2。研究建構3D Swin-UNETR，以自動辨識LARC腫瘤。根據分割所得的腫瘤體積，採用三種分析方法支援後續任務。具體而言，使用PyRadiomics擷取1,132項放射組學特徵（Rf），並利用3D ResNet-152架構取得2,048項深度學習特徵（Dlf）。經一系列特徵篩選步驟後，產生治療反應預測分數，包括RF分數（Rfs）及Dlf分數（Dlfs）。此外，進行端到端分析，自動產生Dl分數（Dls）。接著整合Rfs、Dlfs及Dls，建立多視角特徵工程模型。使用接收者操作特徵曲線下面積（AUROC）評估預測表現。預後指標包括無病存活（DFS）及整體存活（OS），以Kaplan–Meier（KM）分析評估，並使用Log-Rank檢定比較KM曲線。
結果：融合模型在外部驗證隊列1及2的AUROC分別為0.756及0.751，呈現中等辨識能力。模型可有效區分OS風險，所有隊列的p值皆<0.05。DFS的統計顯著性在各隊列間並不一致：開發隊列（p=0.0084）與外部隊列2（p=0.044）達統計顯著，但外部隊列1未達統計顯著（p=0.068）。這些發現屬探索性結果，仍需前瞻性確認。
結論：所提出的AI系統，在評估LARC治療反應及OS風險分層方面，展現經外部驗證的中等表現，未來可能作為協助臨床判斷的決策支援工具。

papers.title: Serum vitamins and inflammatory bowel disease in children: a case-control study
papers.authors: Li X, Li T, Wang Y, Li Y, Zhang S, Yan W
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Micronutrient deficiencies are common in pediatric inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), yet data on multiple vitamin profiles remain limited. This study aimed to comprehensively evaluate serum vitamin levels in children with IBD and explore their associations with immune cell profiles.
METHODS: A retrospective observational study was conducted at the Children's Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University. A total of 46 children diagnosed with IBD who had vitamin profiling were enrolled between March 2022 and March 2026. A control group of 46 healthy children, who underwent health check-ups and vitamin assessments during the same period, were also included, matched 1:1 for age and sex. Clinical and laboratory data were retrieved from the hospital's electronic medical record system. Serum levels of vitamins A, D, E, K, B1, B2, B3, B5, 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, and C were measured using ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry.
RESULTS: Compared with controls, IBD patients had significantly lower vitamin A (VA) and vitamin C (VC) levels, while vitamin E (VE) levels were higher (all P < 0.05). Deficiency rates of VA (76.1% vs. 28.3%), VC (50.0% vs. 26.1%), and vitamin D (41.3% vs. 21.7%) were significantly increased in the IBD group (all P < 0.05). Within the IBD cohort, VA, VD, and VC levels correlated significantly with neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages. Multivariate logistic regression identified lower VA level (OR = 0.159, 95% CI: 0.032-0.792, P = 0.025) and VA deficiency (OR = 7.800, 95% CI: 1.735-35.055, P = 0.007) as factors independently associated with IBD.
CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric IBD patients exhibit significant deficiencies in VA, VC, and VD, and within the IBD cohort, these vitamins (VA, VD, and VC) correlate significantly with neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages. Multivariate regression suggests a potential independent association between VA status and pediatric IBD, though these are preliminary observational findings. This study provides preliminary multi-vitamin profiling data for pediatric IBD, highlighting the need for attention to VA and VC deficiencies alongside routine VD monitoring. Further validation in larger multicenter cohorts is required.

papers.title_zh: 兒童血清維生素與發炎性腸道疾病：病例對照研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：微量營養素缺乏在兒童發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）中相當常見，但同時評估多種維生素概況的資料仍有限。本研究旨在全面評估IBD兒童的血清維生素濃度，並探討其與免疫細胞組成的關聯。
方法：本回溯性觀察研究於鄭州大學附屬兒童醫院進行。研究納入2022年3月至2026年3月間確診IBD且接受維生素檢測的46名兒童。另納入同期接受健康檢查及維生素評估的46名健康兒童作為對照，依年齡與性別進行1:1配對。臨床與實驗室資料取自醫院電子病歷系統。使用超高效液相層析串聯質譜法，測量血清維生素A、D、E、K、B1、B2、B3、B5、5-甲基四氫葉酸及C濃度。
結果：相較於對照組，IBD患者的維生素A（VA）與維生素C（VC）濃度顯著較低，而維生素E（VE）濃度較高（皆P < 0.05）。IBD組的VA缺乏率（76.1% vs. 28.3%）、VC缺乏率（50.0% vs. 26.1%）及維生素D缺乏率（41.3% vs. 21.7%）均顯著較高（皆P < 0.05）。在IBD族群內，VA、VD與VC濃度與嗜中性球及淋巴球百分比有顯著相關。多變項邏輯斯迴歸分析顯示，較低的VA濃度（OR = 0.159，95% CI：0.032–0.792，P = 0.025）及VA缺乏（OR = 7.800，95% CI：1.735–35.055，P = 0.007）為與IBD獨立相關的因素。
結論：兒童IBD患者有顯著的VA、VC及VD缺乏，且在IBD族群內，這些維生素（VA、VD及VC）與嗜中性球及淋巴球百分比有顯著相關。多變項迴歸分析提示，VA狀態可能與兒童IBD有獨立關聯，但這些仍是初步的觀察性發現。本研究提供兒童IBD多種維生素概況的初步資料，強調除例行監測VD外，也需關注VA及VC缺乏。仍需更大型多中心世代研究進一步驗證。

papers.title: S100A11 sustains STRAP stability to drive PI3K/AKT/NF-κB feedforward signalling circuit activation in colorectal cancer progression
papers.authors: Li J, Yang H, Xu Z, Dong H, Kou Z, Lu L
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the most prevalent malignancies worldwide, with persistently low rates of early-stage diagnosis, poor overall prognosis, and a propensity for therapeutic resistance-challenges that underscore the urgent need for deeper mechanistic insight. By integrating single-cell transcriptomic data (GSE161277) with multi-omics datasets from TCGA and GEO repositories, alongside an independent clinical cohort, we identified S100A11 as a consistently overexpressed gene in CRC that correlates significantly with adverse patient outcomes. Functional studies established that S100A11 drives tumour progression by promoting cell proliferation, suppressing apoptosis, and inducing epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT). Mechanistically, S100A11 engages the WD6-7 domain (residues 221-302) of STRAP through direct physical interaction, thereby recruiting the deubiquitylase OTUB1 to shield lysine K246 of STRAP from K63-linked polyubiquitination. This protection stabilises STRAP and facilitates its association with PI3K, culminating in activation of the PI3K/AKT/NF-κB cascade and nuclear translocation of p65. We further demonstrate that p65 binds directly to the promoter regions of both S100A11 and STRAP, transcriptionally upregulating their expression and establishing a self-reinforcing feedforward loop that sustains pathway activation. Collectively, these findings delineate a hierarchical regulatory network centred on the S100A11/STRAP/NF-κB axis and offer a mechanistic framework with potential implications for CRC diagnosis and targeted intervention.
papers.title_zh: S100A11 維持 STRAP 穩定性，驅動大腸直腸癌進展中的 PI3K/AKT/NF-κB 前饋訊號迴路活化
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球最常見的惡性腫瘤之一，早期診斷率持續偏低、整體預後不佳，且容易產生治療抗性；這些挑戰凸顯了深入理解其機制的迫切需求。我們整合單細胞轉錄體資料（GSE161277）、來自 TCGA 與 GEO 資料庫的多體學資料集，以及一個獨立臨床世代，鑑定出 S100A11 是在 CRC 中持續呈現過度表現、且與病人不良預後顯著相關的基因。功能性研究證實，S100A11 藉由促進細胞增殖、抑制細胞凋亡，以及誘導上皮間質轉化（EMT），驅動腫瘤進展。在機制上，S100A11 透過直接物理交互作用，與 STRAP 的 WD6-7 結構域（第 221–302 位胺基酸殘基）結合，進而招募去泛素化酶 OTUB1，保護 STRAP 的第 246 位離胺酸（K246），使其免於發生 K63 連結型多聚泛素化。此保護作用可穩定 STRAP，並促進其與 PI3K 結合，最終導致 PI3K/AKT/NF-κB 訊號級聯反應活化及 p65 核轉位。我們進一步證明，p65 可直接結合 S100A11 與 STRAP 兩者的啟動子區域，在轉錄層級上調其表現，並建立一個自我強化的前饋迴路，以維持訊號路徑活化。整體而言，這些發現描繪出以 S100A11/STRAP/NF-κB 軸為核心的階層式調控網絡，並提供一個對 CRC 診斷及標靶介入可能具有意義的機制架構。

papers.title: IKK16 and SGI1027 induce cytoplasmic vacuolization, and their combination with chemotherapy drugs can enhance the efficacy of cancer therapeutics
papers.authors: Alsubait A, Alghanem B, Ghadbane H, Huwaizi S, Almuhalhil K, Almourfi F
papers.abstract: Cell death represents a critical process in the maintenance of cellular homeostasis. Paraptosis, a mechanism of programmed cell death, is distinguished by extensive cytoplasmic vacuolization. We have identified two commercially available compounds, IKK16 and SGI1027, which can induce cytoplasmic vacuolization leading to paraptosis in cancer cells. We have characterized and studied various cancer cell lines by applying molecular biology, proteomics, gene expression analyses, and microscopy-based techniques. Additionally, our gene expression analyses indicate that GADD45A, and NPC2 genes may serve as potential markers for identifying paraptosis, and validated their involvement in IKK16/SGI1027-mediated paraptosis with a cellular functional assay. Furthermore, the proteomics data revealed a novel set of proteins previously unassociated with paraptosis. We have substantiated our proteomics findings through western blotting and immunocytochemistry in breast and colorectal cancer cell lines, demonstrating similar effects. Moreover, we have shown that combining paraptosis-inducing compounds with anti-cancer drugs can reduce the required overall dosage concentration while preserving therapeutic efficacy, potentially revolutionizing cancer treatment.

papers.title: Spatial immune architecture and immunotherapy resistance in microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Liu X, Liao Q, Cheng Y, Zhou H, Wang R
papers.abstract: Microsatellite-stable (MSS) colorectal cancer (CRC), which accounts for most metastatic CRC, remains largely resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitors. Although low tumor mutational burden and limited neoantigen generation contribute to this resistance, the spatial organization of the tumor microenvironment may also influence antitumor immunity. This review examines mechanisms that establish immune-resistant architectures in MSS CRC, including insufficient T-cell priming, oncogenic signaling, suppressive myeloid niches, hypoxia, abnormal vasculature, and fibroblast-driven extracellular matrix remodeling. We discuss candidate spatial biomarkers, including compartment-specific T-cell distribution, T-cell-tumor-cell distances, multicellular immune neighborhoods, perivascular niches, and the organization and localization of tertiary lymphoid structures. We also examine how fibroblast heterogeneity, collagen architecture, hyaluronan accumulation, and vascular dysfunction can restrict T-cell access and function. Emerging studies associate selected spatial features with treatment outcomes, but the supporting evidence spans small treatment-specific cohorts, mixed CRC populations, and preclinical or non-CRC models. These findings therefore support spatial profiling as a complement to molecular and clinical biomarkers rather than an independently established basis for treatment selection. Prospective studies in defined treatment settings are needed to clarify the relationship between these spatial features and immunotherapy outcomes and to assess their potential to inform combination strategies in MSS CRC.

papers.title_zh: 微衛星穩定型大腸直腸癌的空間免疫結構與免疫治療抗藥性
papers.abstract_zh: 微衛星穩定型（MSS）大腸直腸癌（CRC）占轉移性CRC的大多數，對免疫檢查點抑制劑仍普遍具有抗藥性。雖然低腫瘤突變負荷與新抗原生成有限是造成此抗藥性的因素，腫瘤微環境的空間組織方式也可能影響抗腫瘤免疫。本綜述探討在MSS CRC中形成免疫抗性結構的機轉，包括T細胞初始活化不足、致癌訊號傳遞、抑制性骨髓系細胞微環境、缺氧、異常血管，以及纖維母細胞驅動的細胞外基質重塑。我們討論候選空間生物標記，包括不同區室內的T細胞分布、T細胞與腫瘤細胞之間的距離、多細胞免疫鄰域、血管周圍微環境，以及三級淋巴結構的組織方式與位置。我們也探討纖維母細胞異質性、膠原蛋白結構、玻尿酸堆積及血管功能異常如何限制T細胞的進入與功能。新近研究發現，部分空間特徵與治療結果具有關聯，但其支持證據涵蓋特定治療下的小型世代、混合CRC族群，以及臨床前或非CRC模型。因此，這些發現支持將空間剖析作為分子與臨床生物標記的補充，而非已獨立確立的治療選擇依據。仍需在明確界定的治療情境中進行前瞻性研究，以釐清這些空間特徵與免疫治療結果之間的關係，並評估其在MSS CRC合併治療策略規劃上的潛力。

papers.title: The gut-eye axis in inflammatory bowel disease: shared immune mechanisms and targeted therapies
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is recognized not only as a disease confined to the intestinal tract, but also as a systemic immune-mediated disorder. Among its diverse extraintestinal manifestations, ocular complications, which range from self-limiting episcleritis to severe and sight-threatening uveitis and scleritis, represent a critical clinical challenge that profoundly impacts patient quality of life. This review synthesizes the epidemiological landscape and clinical spectrum of ocular manifestations in IBD, framing their pathogenesis through the emerging concept of the gut-eye axis. We critically examine the shared mechanistic pathways driving this bidirectional relationship, including the systemic dissemination of circulating inflammatory cytokines, aberrant lymphocyte homing, cross-reactive autoantibodies, shared genetic susceptibilities, and microbiota dysbiosis, which collectively compromise the blood-ocular barrier. Furthermore, we outline targeted therapeutic strategies, highlighting that while systemic anti-TNF agents remain the cornerstone for severe and refractory ocular inflammation, gut-selective biologics like vedolizumab necessitate careful application due to the risk of extraintestinal exacerbation. Finally, we underscore the indispensable role of multidisciplinary management and highlight future research trajectories.

papers.title_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病中的腸–眼軸：共同免疫機轉與標靶治療
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）不僅被視為侷限於腸道的疾病，也是一種全身性免疫介導疾病。在其多樣的腸外表現中，眼部併發症涵蓋可自行緩解的上鞏膜炎，到嚴重且威脅視力的葡萄膜炎與鞏膜炎，構成重大臨床挑戰，並深刻影響病人的生活品質。本綜述整合IBD眼部表現的流行病學概況與臨床範疇，並透過新興的腸–眼軸概念闡述其致病機轉。我們批判性檢視驅動此雙向關係的共同機轉路徑，包括循環中發炎性細胞激素的全身性播散、異常的淋巴球歸巢、交叉反應性自體抗體、共同的遺傳易感性，以及微生物相失衡；這些因素共同損害血–眼屏障。此外，我們概述標靶治療策略，強調全身性抗TNF製劑仍是嚴重及難治性眼部發炎的治療基石，而vedolizumab等腸道選擇性生物製劑，則因存在腸外表現惡化的風險而須審慎使用。最後，我們強調多專科共同照護不可或缺的角色，並指出未來研究方向。

papers.title: CXCR2 associated neutrophil stromal interactions and immune exclusion in microsatellite stable colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: Most microsatellite-stable or mismatch-repair-proficient colorectal cancers respond poorly to immune checkpoint monotherapy. This Mini Review examines whether C-X-C motif chemokine receptor 2 (CXCR2)-associated neutrophil recruitment and local stromal interactions contribute to immune exclusion: CD8+ T cells accumulate in stroma or at the tumor margin with limited entry into epithelial nests. We propose that, in a subset of excluded lesions, recruited neutrophils acquire local functions that impair T-cell activity or access. Human observations and experimental perturbations support parts of this model; the complete pathway has not been established as a major cause of checkpoint resistance. Recruitment dependence, tissue adaptation, and measured function provide a basis for comparing studies with different neutrophil labels. Lesions selected for mechanistic investigation would need confirmed microsatellite-stable or mismatch-repair-proficient status, spatial exclusion, and a relevant intratumoral CXCR2-associated neutrophil program. Primary tumors and metastatic sites require separate evaluation. The limited activity of navarixin plus pembrolizumab argues against unselected targeting. Combining CXCR2 inhibition, selected stromal or vascular modulation, and checkpoint blockade remains a preclinical hypothesis. Before clinical translation, comparative studies must link intratumoral target engagement to improved CD8+ T-cell access, function, and tumor control. The proposed tissue biomarkers are research tools whose predictive value requires validation.

papers.title_zh: 微衛星穩定型大腸直腸癌中，CXCR2 相關的嗜中性球與基質交互作用及免疫排斥
papers.abstract_zh: 多數微衛星穩定型或錯配修復功能正常的大腸直腸癌，對免疫檢查點抑制劑單一療法的反應不佳。本篇迷你綜述探討 C-X-C 基序趨化激素受體 2（CXCR2）相關的嗜中性球募集與局部基質交互作用，是否促成免疫排斥：CD8+ T 細胞聚集於基質或腫瘤邊緣，卻很少進入腫瘤上皮細胞巢。我們提出，在部分呈現免疫排斥的病灶中，募集而來的嗜中性球會在局部獲得損害 T 細胞活性或阻礙其進入的功能。人體觀察與實驗性擾動支持此模型的部分環節；但完整路徑尚未被確立為免疫檢查點抑制劑抗藥性的主要原因。對募集的依賴性、組織適應，以及實際測得的功能，可作為比較使用不同嗜中性球標籤之研究的基礎。選作機轉研究的病灶，必須確認其微衛星穩定或錯配修復功能正常的狀態、空間上的免疫排斥，以及腫瘤內存在相關的 CXCR2 相關嗜中性球功能程式。原發腫瘤與轉移部位需要分別評估。Navarixin 合併 pembrolizumab 的有限療效，不支持未經篩選便採用此標靶策略。結合 CXCR2 抑制、選定的基質或血管調控，以及免疫檢查點阻斷，仍屬臨床前假說。在轉譯至臨床之前，比較研究必須證明腫瘤內的標靶作用確實發生，並將其與 CD8+ T 細胞進入、功能及腫瘤控制的改善連結起來。所提出的組織生物標記仍是研究工具，其預測價值有待驗證。

papers.title: Crosstalk between IL-6/JAK/STAT3 and TNF-α/NF-κB signaling in colitis-associated colorectal cancer: epigenetic reprogramming, evidence boundaries, and opportunities for disease management
papers.authors: Yuan J, Liao J, Li F, Xie D, Zuo Z, Zhang D
papers.abstract: Colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CAC) arises through the interaction of chronic mucosal inflammation, genetic evolution and durable changes in gene regulation. Among the inflammatory networks implicated in experimental and human studies, interleukin-6 (IL-6)/Janus kinase (JAK)/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) and tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α)/nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-κB) provide mechanistically informative routes by which cytokine exposure can influence DNA methylation, chromatin regulation and non-coding RNA programs. The best-supported examples include IL-6-associated DNMT1 activity and SOCS3 promoter hypermethylation, NF-κB p65/DNMT3A-associated miR-148a methylation, and STAT3-dependent miR-214 induction. These circuits should be regarded as representative mechanisms supported in specific model systems rather than universal initiating pathways in all human CAC lesions. Recent work further demonstrates that colonic stem cells can retain chromatin accessibility changes after experimental colitis resolves, providing direct evidence for durable inflammatory epigenetic memory. This review therefore separates evidence from human CAC or dysplasia, non-neoplastic inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) mucosa, inflammation-driven animal models, sporadic colorectal cancer (CRC) and cell-line systems. We integrate cytokine-linked epigenetic mechanisms with genetic and clonal evolution, define field cancerization operationally, and distinguish persistent epigenetic memory from transient inflammatory transcription. The translational sections are framed as an outlook: no epigenetic biomarker or epigenetic drug is currently established for CAC surveillance or prevention. We summarize the validation requirements for tissue, blood and stool biomarkers; classify therapeutic concepts by evidence level; and propose a patient-level roadmap for single-cell and spatial studies. The resulting framework emphasizes evidence-graded mechanisms and prospective validation rather than assuming that biologically plausible signals are clinically actionable.

papers.abstract_zh: 結腸炎相關大腸直腸癌（CAC）源於慢性黏膜發炎、遺傳演化與基因調控持久改變之間的交互作用。在實驗及人體研究所涉及的發炎網絡中，介白素-6（IL-6）／Janus 激酶（JAK）／訊息傳遞與轉錄活化因子3（STAT3），以及腫瘤壞死因子α（TNF-α）／核因子κB（NF-κB），提供了有助於理解機轉的途徑，說明細胞激素暴露如何影響 DNA 甲基化、染色質調控與非編碼 RNA 程式。其中證據支持最充分的例子包括：與 IL-6 相關的 DNMT1 活性及 SOCS3 啟動子高甲基化、與 NF-κB p65／DNMT3A 相關的 miR-148a 甲基化，以及依賴 STAT3 的 miR-214 誘導。這些迴路應被視為在特定模型系統中獲得支持的代表性機轉，而非所有人類 CAC 病灶皆適用的普遍起始途徑。近期研究進一步顯示，結腸幹細胞在實驗性結腸炎消退後，仍可保留染色質可及性的變化，為持久的發炎表觀遺傳記憶提供直接證據。因此，本綜述區分來自人類 CAC 或異生病變、非腫瘤性發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）黏膜、發炎驅動的動物模型、散發性大腸直腸癌（CRC），以及細胞株系統的證據。我們將細胞激素相關的表觀遺傳機轉與遺傳及克隆演化加以整合，對場域癌化提出操作型定義，並區分持續性表觀遺傳記憶與短暫的發炎性轉錄反應。轉譯應用章節定位為未來展望：目前尚無任何表觀遺傳生物標記或表觀遺傳藥物，已確立可用於 CAC 監測或預防。我們彙整組織、血液及糞便生物標記所需的驗證條件，依證據等級分類治療概念，並提出病人層級的單細胞與空間研究路線圖。最終建立的架構強調依證據分級的機轉與前瞻性驗證，而非假定具生物學合理性的訊號即可用於臨床決策。

papers.title: Overcoming oxaliplatin resistance and toxicity in colorectal cancer: the emerging role of lipid-based nanocarriers
papers.journal_full: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
papers.authors: Chauhan A, Kumar M, Awasthi A
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To provide a comprehensive overview of lipid-based nanocarriers for oxaliplatin (OXA) delivery in colorectal cancer (CRC), with emphasis on their potential to improve pharmacokinetics, enhance tumour accumulation, enable controlled drug release, and overcome OXA resistance.
METHODS: Relevant literature on OXA, CRC, lipid-based nanocarriers, drug resistance, tumor targeting, co-delivery, and stimuli-responsive delivery systems was reviewed. The review focused on liposomes, solid lipid nanoparticles (SLNs), nanostructured lipid carriers (NLCs), lipid micelles, and advanced lipid-based systems, including passive and active targeting strategies and approaches for overcoming therapeutic resistance.
KEY FINDINGS: Lipid-based nanocarriers demonstrated potential to improve OXA delivery through enhanced tumour accumulation, controlled release, prolonged drug exposure, and improved intracellular uptake. Active targeting using folate, CD44, peptides, or antibodies, along with co-delivery, tumor microenvironment modulation, and externally triggered release, may further enhance therapeutic efficacy and help overcome multidrug resistance. However, most evidence remains preclinical, and challenges including formulation stability, tumor heterogeneity, large-scale manufacturing, and regulatory requirements limit clinical translation.
CONCLUSIONS: Lipid-based nanocarriers represent a promising strategy for improving OXA therapy in CRC, particularly for addressing toxicity, drug resistance, and inefficient tumor delivery. Nevertheless, the limited clinical evidence for OXA-loaded lipid nanocarriers necessitates further pharmacokinetic, toxicological, manufacturing, and well-designed clinical studies before their clinical effectiveness can be established.

papers.title_zh: 克服大腸直腸癌的 oxaliplatin 抗藥性與毒性：脂質奈米載體的新興角色
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：全面概述用於大腸直腸癌（CRC）之 oxaliplatin（OXA）遞送的脂質奈米載體，重點探討其改善藥物動力學、增加腫瘤內累積、實現藥物控制釋放，以及克服 OXA 抗藥性的潛力。
方法：回顧與 OXA、CRC、脂質奈米載體、抗藥性、腫瘤標靶、共同遞送及刺激反應型遞送系統相關的文獻。本綜述聚焦於脂質體、固態脂質奈米粒子（SLNs）、奈米結構脂質載體（NLCs）、脂質微胞及進階脂質系統，涵蓋被動與主動標靶策略，以及克服治療抗性的途徑。
主要發現：脂質奈米載體展現改善 OXA 遞送的潛力，其機制包括增加腫瘤內累積、控制釋放、延長藥物暴露時間，以及改善細胞內攝取。利用葉酸、CD44、胜肽或抗體進行主動標靶，搭配共同遞送、腫瘤微環境調控及外部刺激觸發釋放，可能進一步提升治療效力，並有助於克服多重抗藥性。然而，目前多數證據仍屬臨床前研究，且製劑穩定性、腫瘤異質性、大規模製造及法規要求等挑戰，限制了臨床轉譯。
結論：脂質奈米載體是改善 CRC 之 OXA 治療的一項具潛力策略，尤其可望處理毒性、抗藥性及腫瘤藥物遞送效率不佳等問題。然而，載有 OXA 的脂質奈米載體之臨床證據有限，因此在確立其臨床有效性之前，仍需進一步進行藥物動力學、毒理學、製造及設計良好的臨床研究。

papers.title: From Mechanism to Management: The Link Between Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Cardiovascular Disease
papers.authors: Yasmin F, Ahmed M, Bin Iftikhar T, Rab A, Qazi M, Asghar M
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBDs) constituting the ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn's disease (CD) primarily affect the gastrointestinal tract and have been associated with the development of cardiovascular disease (CVDs). To strengthen this further, the focus of our narrative review is to highlight the clinical significance of understanding this association.
METHODS: We conducted a narrative review to discuss the mechanisms of pathogenesis underlying the link between the management of inflammatory bowel disease and cardiovascular disease.
DISCUSSION: The pathogenesis of the link likely involves dysregulated immune responses leading to overactivation of pro-inflammatory cytokines, suggesting a shared inflammatory pathway. Both diseases share common risk factors such as obesity, diabetes, and gender. Genetic factors, including mutations in NOD2 and CDKN2A, also play a role in the overlap between IBDs and CVDs. Despite the recent developments, conventional cardiovascular risk assessment tools may not fully capture the potential elevated cardiovascular threat in IBD patients.
CONCLUSION: Thus, proactive investigation with advanced diagnostic tools such as coronary artery calcium (CAC) scoring is crucial in reducing cardiovascular morbidity and mortality in these patients. Nevertheless, future research is needed to further clarify disease activity and its correlations.
CLINICAL TRIALS REGISTRATION: NA.

papers.title_zh: 從機轉到管理：發炎性腸道疾病與心血管疾病的關聯
papers.abstract_zh:
前言：發炎性腸道疾病（IBDs）包括潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）與克隆氏症（CD），主要影響胃腸道，且與心血管疾病（CVDs）的發生有關。為進一步闡明此關聯，本敘述性綜述著重強調理解此關聯的臨床重要性。
方法：我們進行敘述性綜述，討論發炎性腸道疾病管理與心血管疾病之間關聯所涉及的致病機轉。
討論：此關聯的致病機轉可能涉及免疫反應失調，導致促發炎細胞激素過度活化，提示兩者具有共同的發炎路徑。兩種疾病具有共同的風險因子，例如肥胖、糖尿病及性別。遺傳因素，包括 NOD2 與 CDKN2A 的突變，也在 IBDs 與 CVDs 的重疊中扮演角色。儘管近期已有進展，傳統心血管風險評估工具可能仍無法完整反映 IBD 病人潛在升高的心血管風險。
結論：因此，使用冠狀動脈鈣化（CAC）評分等進階診斷工具進行積極檢查，對降低這些病人的心血管罹病率與死亡率至關重要。然而，仍需未來研究進一步釐清疾病活動度及其相關性。
臨床試驗註冊：不適用（NA）。
